name: Visual-Inertial Odometry Systems Benchmark
description: A comparative benchmark of four off-the-shelf visual–inertial odometry systems measuring localization accuracy, drift, and robustness under varied conditions.
reputation: Widely used in the robotics community for comparative evaluation of off‑the‑shelf VIO systems; respected for real‑world condition testing though focused in scope.
notes: Evaluations typically report ATE/RPE and drift; benchmark results depend heavily on sensor calibration, synchronization, and trajectory selection. Limited to the tested systems and environments (possible dataset size and system diversity constraints); not an LLM benchmark.
